A_only_interpretation_prereg.logic: consensus_target requires two annotators with identical answer, first_change_id, last_clear_no_change_id, current/reference states and evidence_ids. Therefore A's labels alone can make the registered H gate impossible but can never pass it.
rules: If any of change_supported / no_visible_change / insufficient_evidence is absent from A's 12 derived answers -> H gate cannot pass for any rater B -> record H = FAIL (determined by A) and close the SN7 memory line.
If A marks 5 or more episodes timeout/incomplete -> at most 7 agreeable episodes < 8 -> H = FAIL (determined by A).
Otherwise -> H undetermined; rater B required. Whether to recruit B is a separate decision (SN7 line vs EarthTalk embedding-VLM line) and does not change these rules.
A_only_interpretation_prereg.not_a_claim: A-only results are never reported as human agreement or readability; they are one rater's labels.

pre_reading_addendum_2026_09_25.guide: category definitions clarified (no_visible_change = readable and no structural change observed; ambiguous = visible but uncertain; unreadable = cannot evaluate; visible_change always vs reference). Applied before any evaluation reading; both raters use it.
pre_reading_addendum_2026_09_25.A_only_rule_interpretation_fix: An H FAIL determined by A's labels is a registered-gate outcome that stops D1 L/R. It is NOT evidence that change is invisible at this resolution; a missing category and unreadable imagery are reported as separate causes.
